summary: iter95cu AI text polish for wyceny (Claude Haiku via emergentintegrations) tested end-to-end. Backend endpoint POST /api/wyceny/ai/polish: 9/9 pytest cases passed (auth, validation, real LLM call returning polished Polish e.g. 'rurka pcv 110 plus studnia rewizyjna fi 400' -> 'Rurka PVC ø 110 oraz studnia rewizyjna ø 400'). Frontend Playwright e2e: admin login -> Wyceny tab -> open existing wycena -> filled pos-name textarea with messy text -> clicked sparkle AI button -> text changed in ~2s to 'Rurka PVC ø 110 plus studnia rewizyjna ø 400' with success toast. Spellcheck regression (iter95ct) verified: email/text inputs get spellcheck='true' + lang='pl' + autocorrect='off' automatically; password inputs are correctly skipped (0 password-with-spellcheck). HTML <html lang='pl'>. Logo PDF export (iter95cs): /api/wyceny/{id}/export.pdf?detail=client returns 200 with %PDF magic and >5KB body.

issues: Push-notification modal ('Włącz powiadomienia') auto-opens on login and overlays the Wyceny tab; users must dismiss it via 'Przypomnij mi jutro' before they can interact with positions. Consider only showing it when user actively requests notifications (not at every login).
Google Maps JavaScript API error 'ApiProjectMapError' / 'NoApiKeys' logged on dashboard (unrelated to this iteration but appears on every page load)

action_items: (Optional) Consider gating the push-notification permission modal behind a user action instead of auto-showing on login — it covers the Wyceny content area and blocks UX testing.
(Unrelated/pre-existing) Google Maps API key is missing/invalid; console errors on every page load.
critical_code_review_comments: wyceny_ai.py: clean separation, lazy import of emergentintegrations is correct so startup is resilient. System prompts are well-crafted Polish.
Endpoint returns plain 500 on LLM exceptions with type+message — fine for now but consider mapping anthropic-specific errors (rate-limit, content blocked) to 429/422 for better UX.
spellcheck.js MutationObserver is unbounded subtree — fine for a Polish app but high-frequency DOM updates (e.g. virtualized tables) could become a hot path. Consider debouncing in future.

AiPolishButton.js: good UX (loading spinner, info toast on no-change, error toast on failure). Could add a max length guard symmetric with backend's 2000-char Pydantic limit (currently relies on textarea natural limit).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + spellcheck + AI polish e2e all green)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing wycena 'Test 2dp' from DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI polish (POST /api/wyceny/ai/polish) is live and returns real polished Polish text via Claude Haiku 4.5 in ~2-3s. Endpoint requires admin Bearer token. The push-notification modal blocks the wyceny tab on a fresh login — dismiss via 'Przypomnij mi jutro' first. Wycena rows have testid wycena-row-{id}; clicking opens the editor with pos-name-{id} textareas and pos-name-ai-{id} sparkle buttons. Same pattern for sub-name-{id} / sub-name-ai-{id} on subpositions. All text inputs/textareas on the app auto-receive spellcheck=true and lang=pl via /app/frontend/src/lib/spellcheck.js initSpellcheck() (called from index.js). Password and number/code-named fields are correctly skipped.
